description: This PHP source file provides utility functions related to module field management in SuiteCRM, including fetching module fields, related modules, relationships, and rendering form components for editing and display. It also includes functions for handling user assignment, date formatting, and field validation.

methods.name: getModuleFields
methods.description: Retrieves available fields for a specified module, with options to filter by view type and validity, considering access permissions and blocked fields.

methods.name: getRelModuleFields
methods.description: Fetches fields from a related module given a module and relationship field, leveraging getModuleFields for the related module.

methods.name: getRelatedModule
methods.description: Determines the related module based on a module name and link fields string, following relationships.

methods.name: getModuleTreeData
methods.description: Provides a JSON structure indicating module hierarchy and linked modules, respecting access controls.

methods.name: getModuleRelationships
methods.description: Returns a list of relationships of a module, focusing on linked fields and related modules.

methods.name: getValidFieldsTypes
methods.description: Determines valid data types for a particular field in a module, based on field definitions.

methods.name: getModuleField
methods.description: Generates form HTML or display for a specific field in a module, accommodating different view types, data conversions, and dependencies.

methods.name: createBracketVariableAlias
methods.description: Converts a bracketed variable string into a format suitable for JS variable naming.

methods.name: getDateField
methods.description: Generates date-related form elements, such as dropdowns and input fields, based on configuration.

methods.name: getDateFields
methods.description: Returns options for date-type fields in a module, for use in dropdowns or validation.

methods.name: getAssignField
methods.description: Creates an assignment selection HTML component, allowing choice among roles, security groups, and users.

methods.name: getDropdownList
methods.description: Builds HTML options for a dropdown list from predefined list identifiers.

methods.name: getLeastBusyUser
methods.description: Selects the user with the fewest assigned records based on a specified field.

methods.name: getRoundRobinUser
methods.description: Assigns a user in a round-robin fashion from a list of users, with caching.

methods.name: setLastUser
methods.description: Stores the last assigned user for a given workflow or process in session and cache files.

methods.name: getEmailableModules
methods.description: Returns modules that contain email-able contact fields, based on bean classes.

methods.name: getRelatedEmailableFields
methods.description: Finds linked fields within a module that can hold email addresses, useful for email communication features.

methods.name: fixUpFormatting
methods.description: Converts date, time, and numeric values into normalized database formats, considering locale-specific formatting.
